## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` & `pnpm format:check` pass
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Tests added/updated (`pnpm test`, e2e if applicable)
- [ ] A11y considered (keyboard, contrast, reduced-motion)
- [ ] ADR added/updated if this changes architecture
- [ ] Sidecar docs updated per `AGENTS.md` §3; if `docs/` changed, `pnpm --filter @quarry/docs sync` was run and the mirror committed
